comment: The stable REST API error-code registry (specs/05-backend-and-jobs.md §2). This file is the source of truth for `ApiError.error.code`; `specs/12-roadmap.md` WP-0.2 requires that it equals the `ErrorCode` enum in `packages/schemas/api/error.schema.json`, and `pnpm schemas:gen` fails if the two drift. Codes are never renamed or reused: a removed code stays here with `"deprecated": true` so old clients keep working.

codes.description: No session or bearer token on an authenticated route (05 §2, §8).
Authenticated, but not allowed to touch this project, asset or job.
The project, asset, analysis, job, plan or library item does not exist (or the user cannot see it).
The request body failed its route schema, or an op batch failed validation (02 §4.3).
Compare-and-swap on refs failed: the branch changed on another device (05 §7).
Per-user rate limit hit: 100 req/min API, 500 library imports/hour (05 §11).
The user is out of credits for this capability (05 §9).
Upload above the configured size limit (500 MB) or a body above the route's limit (04 §3.1).
The asset is not audio the pipeline can decode (04 §3.1).
Audio above the configured duration limit (30 minutes) (04 §3.1, §10).
The file is damaged or is not audio at all; ingest failed with a user-facing reason (04 §10).
The user's credit balance cannot pay for this job (05 §9, 09 §5).
The daily GPU-seconds budget is spent, so an interactive generation cannot start now; the client offers a retry (05 §9, 09 §5).
GET/DELETE /jobs/{id} for an unknown job (05 §2).
The job was cancelled (DELETE /jobs/{id}, 05 §4.4).
A model or worker failed. Retryable per the job event's `retryable` flag (05 §3, §4.3).
A dependency (Postgres, NATS, S3, an LLM call) is unavailable.
The global daily GPU-seconds cap is hit: background jobs pause, interactive jobs get "busy" (05 §9).
A pushed commit names a parent the server has not seen (05 §7).
An unhandled server error. The message is generic; the detail goes to Sentry/OTel (05 §11).
